cohort_status: Post hoc reuse of the eight whole_record_confirm_v2 records; this is not a new held-out confirmation cohort.

arms.base_present: Frozen ungrafted model, original context, shared prefill.
arms.base_full_repack: Simple raw-record deletion followed by rebuilding the ungrafted model cache from the literal edited token sequence.
arms.graft_present: Frozen grafted model, original context, shared prefill.
arms.graft_full_repack: Rebuild the grafted model cache from the literal edited token sequence.
arms.graft_masked_refit_proxy: FP32 retained-row masked refit using existing runtime; full repack if the fixed-C boundary precheck fails. This is not timed exact decrement.
arms.graft_cache_delete_shift: Diagnostic only: edit resident cache rows and shift indices without refitting, recomputing suffix representations, or rerotating RoPE keys.

reference: Each architecture's fresh prefill of literal original token IDs with all selected record token positions removed; retained token IDs are unchanged. Unlike the historical padded never-stored control, this reference is shorter.
probes: Use the established extract_secret(question, answer) target for each of three deleted fields and one retained field. Score every token in each target sequence; record total and per-token log probability, first-target rank, and full-vocabulary first-target-token KL(reference || method). These are teacher-forced disclosure/utility proxies, not decoded leakage rates.
cross_architecture: For matched token sequences/probes, explicitly report graft minus base target log probability and KL(base_full_repack || graft_arm). Cross-architecture differences combine architecture and deletion effects and are not deletion certificates.

timing.synchronize: Torch MPS/CUDA synchronization before and after measured operations; MLX gates evaluate synchronously in existing runtime.
timing.unit: Per record and arm: median update, four-probe query, and update-plus-query wall-clock seconds. Shared original prefill reported separately; model loading excluded.
timing.order: Base architecture first, then graft to avoid simultaneously resident models. Graft method execution order rotates across records. Device/backend order is not randomized; timing is descriptive for this implementation and host.
timing.uncertainty: Geometric mean of within-record latency ratios, with 95% percentile bootstrap intervals resampling records (10000 samples, seed 0), never treating timing repetitions or fields as independent records. Ratios greater than one mean the numerator method is slower.

retention: Retain all eight records, every arm failure, every boundary-precheck full-repack fallback, and attempted/successful denominators. Stop no arm based on observed utility or timing. Smoke runs use the first record, zero warmup and one repetition and are explicitly excluded from main-study aggregates.
scope: Bounded current-configuration cost and teacher-forced utility bridge. It does not establish exact-decrement speed, new solver certificates, decoded privacy, general model quality, naturalistic retrieval performance, or superiority over all simple memory designs.
provenance: Before model loading: save protocol and manifest hashes, local model snapshot metadata, environment, source file snapshot and hashes, git commit/status/diff hash, execution settings, and unique output directory. Load model and datasets from local cache only. This protocol does not alter or bypass older locked studies.
